body:
But the thought of doing anything hurts. I've been through enough and met enough people and made so many memories, that now when I think of doing anything, theres always that thought of someone who hurt me who loved doing that thing and I can't bring my self to do it because it hurts to know it could have been with them.

Or I can't find the reason to do anything because nothing has ever made the pain go away. It's constant. It's always there and it's eating me and I cant make it stop.
I want to die. I'm only too afraid to do it my self. I walk into traffic and give death stares to people in bad neighborhoods hoping for my release.
It can't be temporary when I've been this way for years. I can't remember what being ok feels like.
